subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and which runtime/session surfaces should consume it?
rationale: The remaining work changes stable runtime/session semantics and provider-cost precedence, so implementation should wait for a maintainer decision on API shape rather than guessing through a narrow repair.

options.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
options.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback to existing local estimates when exact data is unavailable.

options.title: Keep exact cost outside core
options.body: Leave OpenClaw core on estimated cost fields and route exact OpenRouter billing to a plugin or external ledger surface.

options.title: Fold into broader usage ledger
options.body: Defer this issue until a native per-call usage ledger and agent-facing usage API define the shared contract.

recommendation.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
recommendation.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source, units, raw details, and fallback to existing local estimates when exact data is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-history connection to OpenRouter billed-cost reconciliation and the adjacent runtime/session usage surfaces.
